fields.before: This assessment covers the formal opening statements, rebuttals, scheduled cross-examination and both closing statements (approximately 2:10–1:27:00). Moderator introductions and logistics, the entire audience Q&A with every dependent answer and reply, and concluding host material are excluded at the editor’s request. Neither speaker receives credit, penalties, or an inference of failing to reply from excluded material. These scores assess the formal rounds, not the complete recording. The complete English automatic captions were reviewed against a participant-published partial transcript for the opening and rebuttal rounds. A short speaker-labelled audio check corroborated one exchange; unclear words remain excluded from scoring and quotations. Captions and timestamps are preserved without silent correction.
